name: TofuTracker
description: Scrobbles movies and TV episodes (including anime) played in Jellyfin to TofuTracker. Each Jellyfin user links their own TofuTracker account with a short code. Reports playback progress, completed plays, and episodes or movies you mark as played by hand.
overview: Sends what you watch in Jellyfin to your TofuTracker library.

versions.changelog: - Initial release: playback and manual "mark played" scrobbling, per-user linking
